name: XASPU
description: 32-bit era 4-bit XA ADPCM codec and 4-point Gaussian DAC interpolator lo-fi processor.

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: SPU voice sample clock (0 = 6 kHz dark loop, 50 = 19.6 kHz VAG, 100 = 44.1 kHz).

params.name: ADPCM
params.explanation: 4-bit XA ADPCM intensity and predictor drive (0 = 16-bit PCM, 50 = 4-bit XA, 100 = slope-overload crunch).

params.name: Pred
params.explanation: Sony SPU ADPCM differential IIR predictor filter (FLAT, XA 1..4).

params.name: Gauss
params.explanation: DAC reconstruction (0 = ZOH steps, 35 = linear, 75 = PS1 4-point Gaussian, 100 = warm pillow).

params.name: Width
params.explanation: Stereo sample width (0 = mono 512KB RAM-saver voice, 100 = full stereo).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).
